versions.changelog:
Initial release of trade-signal — real-time trade signals and stock analysis.

- Provides actionable Buy/Sell/Hold recommendations with entry/exit targets for global stocks, ETFs, and options strategies.
- Supports in-depth analysis: earnings, technicals, analyst ratings, management commentary, SEC filings, trends, and more.
- Covers 37,000+ stocks and 6,000+ ETFs across major US, European, and Asian markets.
- Integrates data from top institutional sources: Wall Street research, real-time news, company filings, earnings transcripts, and analyst actions.
- Includes command-line script for querying financial data and outputting structured, citation-backed JSON responses.
